_comment: Polished granite: a speckled grey, pink and white coarse-grained igneous stone, ground and polished to a near-mirror countertop finish (ambientCG Granite001A, CC0, its polished 'A' variant; roughness map mean 0.05). Opaque: a solid dielectric; granite does not scatter light through like marble. The source states no physical size: meters_per_tile 0.4 is a judgement from the grain size (crystals of about 3-5 mm span 7-13 px of the 1024 px tile). Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): scratches (overlay 1, damage), dust as a deposit (Phase10), water spots, gated by the Crevice mask. Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: Granite_Polished_Clean_Base_s1_v01

sources.why: specular_ior 1.54, that of quartz (Physically Based 'Quartz'), granite's main mineral with feldspar (about 1.52-1.53); Physically Based has no granite entry. meters_per_tile 0.4 from the grain size, since the source states no physical size.
